messages:
Sophie (CSM): Heads up — SummitWorks told us they're piloting an internal knowledge-search across 2 new squads (Insights + Docs). They want embeddings + a reranker, initial estimate 20k queries/day with a projected ramp to ~200k/day over 6 weeks. Asking for onboarding checklist, throughput bump, and performance targets. Renewal ~60 days out; potential to convert to Dedicated if perf/cost looks good. @Emma (CS) can you coordinate? :eyes:

Emma (CS): on it — scheduled a sync with their platform lead for Thu. Need ETA on latency and token cost for our recommended model stack. Also request a 10k-query sample set from them for eval and regression checks.

Raj (Eng): for throughput, recommend starting with 2 dedicated v3 pods + prefix/KV caching. Rerank at scale will need kv cache tuning and batching. Suggest quantized 13B for embeddings and optimized 7B for rerank to balance cost/quality. Any constraints on model families from their infra/security teams?

Olivia (Infra): are they going Private/VPC or hosted? If Private/VPC: we should pre-check KMS requirements and egress rules. Cross-region replicas might be needed if their squads are distributed.

Mike (Sales): flagged in CRM — expansion + renewal is a good upsell window. If engineering shows a 2x token cost reduction via batching/caching, we can push Dedicated. I'll prep a contract addendum option.

Emma (CS): @Sophie please drop the sample CSV/queries into the onboarding drive and paste the playbook link here once done. I'll add the eval checklist and perf targets. Also need a 2-week burst window for end-to-end smoke tests the week after next.

summitwork-bot: scheduled sync created — Thu 10:00am PT with SummitWorks platform lead (@jkim).

Sophie (CSM): uploaded sample to the drive and shared the playbook: https://redwood.internal/onboard/playbooks/summitworks (internal). Added a short note about expected SLA targets (p95 latency < 300ms for rerank).

Olivia (Infra): can provision a burst: will open ticket INFRA-4829 to provision autoscale caps and a short-lived replica in us-west-2 for tests. Need confirmation on data residency and KMS key id.

Raj (Eng): quick config suggestion to seed the pilot (we can tune after the eval):

```
model_stack:
  embeddings: 'redwood/emb-13b-quant'
  reranker: 'redwood/rank-7b-opt'
capacity:
  dedicated_pods: 2
  burst_slots: 50
  kv_cache: enabled
```

Emma (CS): I'll run the eval once infra confirms burst window. Plan: 10k sample -> perf run -> quality checks -> 1-week smoke in staging -> production pilot.

Sophie (CSM): action items noted: 1) collect sample + playbook (done), 2) infra ticket for burst (INFRA-4829), 3) eng config + eval (Raj/Emma), 4) sales addendum draft (Mike). I also marked renewal touchpoints and will schedule a commercial check-in 30 days before renewal.

Mike (Sales): I’ll draft the addendum and join Thu sync. :thumbsup: 

Emma (CS): moving to the onboarding checklist. Will post updates in this thread after the perf run.

Sophie (CSM): thanks team — this looks like a strong expansion signal. I'll capture customer feedback during the pilot and flag any quality regressions early.
